name: cronrunner
description: Cross-platform local cron job manager with an LLM-assisted job builder

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/server build
scripts.compile: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/server embed && bun run --cwd apps/server compile
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/server typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.package: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/server embed && bun apps/server/scripts/package.ts
